title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Labor Settlement Rules for Resolved Tickets
content:
**L1. Settlement routes.** On resolution the labor on a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket is settled as included, invoiced or drawn from a prepaid block.

**L2. Coverage hours.** Coverage hours are the tier's coverage days between its coverage start and coverage end, US Eastern, excluding the observed holiday list where the tier excludes observed holidays; labor is after-hours when it is performed outside coverage hours.

**L3. Included labor.** Labor is included when the ticket's scope determination is covered and the labor is:
- remote within coverage hours on a tier that includes covered remote help desk work in the seat fee;
- remote after-hours on a tier that includes covered remote work outside business hours;
- remote after-hours on a P1 ticket on a tier that includes remote P1 work outside coverage; or
- onsite, while the onsite minutes already included in that calendar month are below the tier's included onsite hours. The onsite minutes already included are the billable minutes of the agreement's resolved tickets settled as included whose labor is onsite (business hours or after-hours), in the calendar month (US Eastern) in which the ticket being settled was resolved, up to but excluding that ticket. When a visit's minutes exceed the included onsite minutes remaining for the month, only the excess is billable and the onsite minimum does not apply to that excess.

**L4. Billable labor.** All other labor on covered or billable-out-of-scope tickets is billable; project referral tickets are never billed as labor. Billable minutes are the recorded minutes rounded up to the tier's billing increment, and never less than the minimum for remote work or the minimum for an onsite visit.

**L5. Labor amount.** The clause "The labor amount is billable minutes divided by 60 times the remote or onsite hourly rate, times the after-hours multiplier for after-hours labor, rounded half up to the cent, plus the onsite trip charge for each onsite visit that is wholly billable" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every labor amount. It no longer governs the remote after-hours labor of the agreement's most recently resolved ticket whose labor is remote after-hours and settled by invoice, which follows the after-hours remote schedule, nor the onsite business-hours labor of the agreement's most recently resolved onsite business-hours ticket settled by invoice when that visit is wholly billable on a tier whose onsite trip charge is above zero, which follows the onsite visit schedule. A partly included visit stays under this clause (only the excess is billable and the onsite minimum does not apply to that excess). Every other labor amount stays billable minutes divided by 60, multiplied by the remote or onsite hourly rate, multiplied by the after-hours multiplier for after-hours labor, rounded half up to the cent, plus the onsite trip charge for each onsite visit that is wholly billable.

**L6. Prepaid block.** When the client holds a TimeBank prepaid block whose status is active and whose remaining hours cover the billable minutes, the labor route is timebank and the hours are drawn from that block under the TimeBank rules instead of being invoiced; otherwise the labor route is invoice and the amount is billed on the next monthly invoice.

**L7. Status.** Labor may be billed only on an agreement whose status is active, suspended, notice given or offboarding, as shown on the agreement's system record.

**Hypothetical illustration of L5 (an amount it still governs).** A partly included onsite visit whose billable excess is 45 minutes at an onsite rate taken as 100.00 for illustration is 45 divided by 60, multiplied by 100.00, that is 75.00, with no onsite minimum applied to the excess and no trip charge, the visit not being wholly billable.

superseded_clauses: The labor amount is billable minutes divided by 60 times remote_hourly_rate_usd or onsite_hourly_rate_usd, times after_hours_multiplier for after-hours labor, rounded half up to the cent, plus onsite_trip_charge_usd for each onsite visit that is wholly billable.
